description: Canonical no-authority software-maintenance transition record: state + retrieved evidence + action + observation + verifier result + next state.

field_contract.action: Typed next operation with action_label and bounded arguments.
field_contract.anti_cheat_contract: No target-coded IDs, no shortcut labels, no split overlap, no hidden refs, no raw leak in forbidden fields.
field_contract.authority: Per-row authority flags. Defaults closed. Cannot override registry authority.
field_contract.loss_mask: Declares which losses this row is authorized to train. Forbidden losses must be false by default.
field_contract.observation: Tool/test/error/log/static-analysis observation normalized into typed fields.
field_contract.provenance: Source lineage, license/security/risk refs, teacher/verifier refs, and generation method.
field_contract.record_id: Opaque stable ID; must not encode target label, action, split, or verifier result.
field_contract.retrieval_context: References to retrieved evidence cards, source inventory IDs, API cards, paper operator cards, or repo graph nodes. Store refs, not hidden material.
field_contract.reward_signal: pass/fail/helpful/harmful/inconclusive plus value labels where available.
field_contract.split: train|eval|strict_eval|holdout; split must be assigned before model input serialization.
field_contract.state_after: Expected or observed next structured state. For supervised rows, must be verifier-backed or explicitly marked synthetic_teacher_pending_verification.
field_contract.state_before: Structured state object. No raw source/body unless route explicitly permits and authority remains closed for this schema stage.
field_contract.task_family: Intent/build, repo graph, symbol binding, edit localization, patch operator, verifier repair, bounded argument, denoise repair, or research transfer.
field_contract.telemetry_contract: Required telemetry artifacts for any probe consuming this record.
field_contract.tool_result: Result from the action if available; use NOT_RUN for design/pre-execution rows.
field_contract.verifier_result: Typed verifier state and evidence refs. Must not be inferred from target-coded fields.
